body.p: Claim 1-13 are pending. Claim 3 has been objected to due to informalities, and claim 1 has been rejected under the doctrine of obviousness-type double patenting based on claim 1 of commonly owned U.S. Patent No. 11,760,493. Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration based on the amended claim, attached Terminal Disclaimer, and the following discussion.
Applicant gratefully acknowledges the allowability of all pending claims over the prior art of record.
Claim 3 has been amended to depend from pending claim 2. Withdrawal of this rejection and reconsideration are respectfully requested.

A properly executed Terminal Disclaimer is filed concurrently with this paper under relevant portions of 35 USC § 1.321, thereby obviating the above-noted rejection. Withdrawal and reconsideration is respectfully requested.
In summary, the above-captioned application is in an allowable condition and an expedited Notice of Allowability is earnestly solicited.

If the Examiner wishes to expedite disposition of this matter, the Examiner is invited to contact Applicant's named representative at the telephone number listed below. The Examiner is further authorized to use electronic transmission to contact Applicant's representative at the e- mail address listed below.

As noted, a one (1) month Extension of Time Fee along with the Terminal Disclaimer Fee are herein filed concurrently with this paper. No other fees are due and owing. However, the Office is herein expressly authorized to deduct any fees, additional fees or additional extensions of time from Applicant's Deposit Account 50-3010 and to credit any overpayments thereto.
